comparison.objective: Install a grounding set in the safe ground-first order and verify clamp retention.
comparison.physical_skill: Hang two clamps, turn eye screws to achieve force, manage a linked cable, and preserve electrical sequencing.
comparison.success_condition: Ground and line clamps reach specified force on the correct bars in order and pass 40 N tug checks without contacting prohibited bars.
comparison.reason: Both involve torque and post-installation physical verification, but this record tests ordered placement of clamps on separate bars and retention under tug load. It lacks fine tool insertion, unlock-adjust-relock sequencing, and iterative dynamic tuning.
